subject: Object property
notes: cite.py --check 8.4.3.9.3 'a set property method shall exist for property-name-1' OK. OoWrapPropertyOps classifies the occurrence (Write/ReadWrite) and raises COBOL0843 SR4 when op.Set is null; the same property stays readable as a sender. OoSpineTests.PropertyReference_ReceivingWithNoSet_0843 asserts both halves (MOVE 9 TO BAL OF A rejected, sending use accepted). [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (the object property is part of the OO facility introduced by ISO/IEC 1989:2002; absent from X3.23-1985)]
